description: Election Commission - Parliamentary Election - 2024 Order Under Section 6 (3) of the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act, No.03 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes and election-related matters, including requirements for political parties and candidates to submit election campaign income/expenditure returns, legal provisions under election laws, and appointments of election officials to assist Returning Officers in electoral districts. The content focuses entirely on parliamentary election administration and compliance with election expenditure regulations, fitting squarely within the Elections category (Type 7).
